I called at 8am, spoke to reception who said I had to go to their website (which is very unclear) to book. I did it and I was told I would receive a call at somepoint before 6.30pm TOMORROW if I'm going to eb seen for an appointment.
How am I supposed to manage this when I have work? Take 2 days off to maybe get an appointment so I can take a call at some point?

Receptionist says it's better, maybe for them, but not for your average person who works and pays taxes to fund this.

Awful.",null,[0,238]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pkdFdEaFhOWGRUT0ZBeGRWRnlVV2N3V0UwMVpVRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xa15001a0a3222538!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOjdtWDhXNXdTOFAxdVFyUWcwWE01ZUE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pkdFdEaFhOWGRUT0ZBeGRWRnlVV2N3V0UwMVpVRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiY-NG19LeTAxULKGMBHRqOJyYQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiY-NG19LeTAxULKGMBHRqOJyYQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUZCV0ROZlgxOWZSV2hFWm1Oa1IxSm5WbTFJYjNKRldFMUlZMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpRUVVOWk1tSTFWMmxyV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25sRllVUlJaekJJYW5CM1JXUkRhbU13WlZsT1ZsRRAB",["0x0:0xa15001a0a3222538",null,1774266009983097,1774267185130361,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/110862494343091002506/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Pamela Millard","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUuEZqHNkAm58HdgWZMdhcwwVRa2UJVJZrRvthNfrM7RODVS9wx=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/110862494343091002506?hl=en"],"110862494343091002506",null,1,0,null,[0,2,1],0,["1 review",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiY-NG19LeTAxULKGMBHRqOJyYQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"18 hours ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I usually sing the praises of my gp’s practice but the new econsult system is overly complicated, cumbersome and time consuming.

I’m sure on paper and the sales pitch undoubtedly received made it sound fantastic, but the reality is it’s incredibly laborious and inaccessible for the majority of the people it’s designed to help.

Did anybody test this with real people before rolling it out or did it just go down the Microsoft route and get launched and bugs (will/will not) get addressed when users start complaining?",null,[0,128]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25sRllVUlJaekJJYW5CM1JXUkRhbU13WlZsT1ZsRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xa15001a0a3222538!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOnlFYURRZzBIanB3RWRDamMwZVlOVlE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25sRllVUlJaekJJYW5CM1JXUkRhbU13WlZsT1ZsRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiY-NG19LeTAxULKGMBHRqOJyYQoykIBygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiY-NG19LeTAxULKGMBHRqOJyYQ0pMFCAUoAQ"],null,"CAESYENBRVFBaHBDUTJrNFNVRlNTVzVEWjI5QlVEZGZURjlmWDE5ZlgxOWZSV2hFYzBSdVMyZHFWa2x3WlhObWMxTkxiMEZCUVVGQlIyZG1YMEZ0VEd4aU1HZFdSMEZCYVVGQg=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xORlFWVmxjVVowV2tkVWRIaGxNa3h5WlhKdmVVRRAB",["0x0:0xa15001a0a3222538",null,1773401100133718,1773401100133718,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/111195407338789192100/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Robyn","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUnui6t7274a5_rdZz7_3ztwIXzhAHFo8FdweGQ9AZUYrSlod-PFA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/111195407338789192100?hl=en"],"111195407338789192100",null,3,0,null,[0,3,1],2,["3 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiY-NG19LeTAxULKGMBHRqOJyYQ7LoGCAkoAA"]]]],null,"a week ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Worst GP I've ever been registered at. It was very difficult to get an appointment previously via the phone, now it's almost impossible with the new online system. You are required to answer a detailed questionnaire in order to make a request to see a doctor, which is then assessed by them and they decide if they will see you or not. The two times I have done this recently they have denied my request to see a doctor with no opportunity to respond as you can't reply to their messages. This system is ableist and discriminatory, I have autism and other disabilities and filling in an online form like that is not easy. I can't imagine how difficult it must be for elderly people or those even less able. You are directly discriminating against people with disabilities by forcing them to use a poorly designed and over complicated booking system. Appalling service, seems to be designed specifically so they have more control over who they choose to see in the practice, which is in direct contrast to the UK legislation regarding access to care for all patients on the NHS.",null,[0,234]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xORlFWVmxjVVowV2tkVWRIaGxNa3h5WlhKdmVVRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xa15001a0a3222538!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOlNFQVVlcUZ0WkdUdHhlMkxyZXJveUE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xORlFWVmxjVVowV2tkVWRIaGxNa3h5WlhKdmVVRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiY-NG19LeTAxULKGMBHRqOJyYQoykICigB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiY-NG19LeTAxULKGMBHRqOJyYQ0pMFCAgoAg"]]]]
